text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's debut race will be in a
few days,
but before then, she decides
to do a partner run
with Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I did it! I reached finish line without
you passing
me once, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? But I always manage to overtake
you...
Something's different about you
today...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay! You mean all my training is paying
off?!
Woohoo!
choice_data_list: That's proof you're getting into peak form.
That's proof you're getting into peak form.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia! Thanks for always doing partner
runs with
me! I couldn't have gotten this
far without you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nothing at all! Your debut race is soon,
right? Do
your best, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of her debut race has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? There's somewhere I
wanna go
before the race starts. Is that
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black leads us to Tokyo
Racecourse's
track.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here it is... The very first stage of my
running
career...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've still got plenty of growing to do, but
I don't
plan on disrespecting the
audience in any way. I'm
going to do my
very best here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's have a good race today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black bows to the racecourse.
The race
we've dedicated so much time
and energy to is
about to begin.
